address: Hôtel Monsieur George, 17 rue Washington, Paris, 75008, France
bio: The small, exquisitely appointed restaurant of the Art deco-inspired Monsieur George bijou hotel is plush without being starched and ideal for a twinkly date night. The chef conjures up delicate, aromatic dishes, whose elegance and technically flawless craftsmanship pamper the tastebuds thanks to expressive, harmonious combinations. Top-drawer produce is cleverly crafted in tune with the zeitgeist, illustrated by his couscous inspired Lozère lamb, flanked by quinoa tabouleh, lamb stock and home-made harissa. The desserts are equally knockout. The quintessence of fine dining paired with suitably polished but unfawning service....
